headline: A 2020 law lets the Department of Veterans Affairs allow a memorial display honoring deceased service members in any national cemetery.
what_it_does: The law says the Department of Veterans Affairs may authorize the display of a Fallen Soldier Display in any national cemetery. A Fallen Soldier Display is a memorial monument honoring members of the Armed Forces who have died. The official summary does not describe any money, eligibility, or rule changes beyond this authorization.
